description: The Original Nike Air Jordan 4 "Fire Red" earned its fame through countless battles on the feet of Michael Jordan. Whether MJ was battling the Pistons, Pacers, Hawks, or Cavaliers from his own conference or Magic Johnson and the Lakers from the Western Conference, the game was brutal back then, which made the things MJ did and the shoes he wore that much more special. The OG Fire Red 4 was one of just a handful of original colorways applied to the Tinker Hatfield designed sneaker. Unlike the Black Cement colorway, the white leather upper of the Fire Red Jordan 4 meant that accent colors like black and red contrasted strongly and showcased Tinker’s detail in design--like the mesh side panel, plastic "arms" that locked in the sides when laced--work even more. Of course the 1989 Air Jordan 4 Fire Red also featured the huge Nike Air branding on the heel, along with the Jumpman logo and scripted Flight logo on the extended tongue. But back in 1989, it was that visible Air cushioning unit in the heel that captured the attention of kids around the world. It seems like an afterthought today but seeing through the bottom of your shoes was magical back in 1989. The insole is white with a tonal Jumpman logo that matches the sock liner. An OG Wings logo is stamped into the heel counter.

What we really like about this shoe is the dependability of the signature foam midsole encapsulating an Air unit in its heel, all resting on top of a white rubber outsole. The Jordan 1 Low Triple White (Women's), sneaker was released on September 14, 2022 for an original retail price of $90.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Starfish (Women's)
description:
The leather upper of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Starfish W features a white base, contrasting orange overlays, and a high-cut collar in chocolate brown.

This women's Air Jordan 1 OG Starfish also boasts a woven Nike Air tag embellishing a lightly padded nylon tongue in a vintage off-white finish. The aged aesthetic is repeated on the rubber midsole of the sneaker, fitted with an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the heel and supported underfoot by an orange rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Starfish W was released on the 27th of October 2022, and initially retailed at $180.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Metallic Silver Tiempo
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Metallic Silver Tiempo brings a sleek, high shine metallic treatment to the classic low top Jordan 1 silhouette, combining white and metallic silver with black accents for a genuinely striking presentation. The Tiempo naming may reference Nike's storied football boot lineage, suggesting a design concept drawing inspiration from that respected performance heritage. Metallic silver detailing gives this pair a distinctly futuristic, high shine quality that sets it apart from more traditional Jordan 1 color releases.

Metallic finishes have grown increasingly popular within sneaker design, offering a fresh, contemporary twist on classic silhouettes that were originally released decades earlier. This white and metallic silver combination gives the Jordan 1 Low a genuinely modern edge, appealing to collectors who want their retro pairs to feel current rather than purely nostalgic. Fans of both Jordan Brand's storied history and metallic detailing find this SE release a compelling way to experience the silhouette through an entirely new visual lens.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Metallic Silver Tiempo was released on April 14, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Metallic Black
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Metallic Black brings the iconic 1985 cut of the Air Jordan 1 to a low-top version, providing a fresh take on one of the most beloved models in sneaker history. Featuring a clean white, black, and neutral grey colorway, this low-top version offers the same timeless appeal and cultural significance as the original high-top. The metallic black accents on the swoosh and other detailing add a sleek, modern twist, perfect for those looking to blend classic style with contemporary streetwear.

The Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 retains all the elements that made the original Jordan 1 a cultural phenomenon, from the premium leather construction to the classic Nike Air branding. This low-top version is perfect for sneaker enthusiasts who want a more versatile, easy-to-wear option without sacrificing the boldness of the original design. Its influence on both basketball and streetwear culture remains undeniable, making this release a must-have for any collection.

Released on October 2, 2024, the Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Metallic Black retailed for $160. This model continues the legacy of the Air Jordan 1, offering both heritage and modern flair in one stylish package.

title: Jordan 1 Low OG Rookie of the Year
description:
The Jordan 1 Low OG Rookie of the Year pays homage to Michael Jordan's stellar first season in the NBA. This sleek sneaker features a premium Sail leather upper, accented with Black overlays and Golden Harvest details. The iconic Swoosh logo in Gym Red adds a pop of color, while the classic Air Jordan Wings logo on the heel completes the retro look.

Designed for both style and comfort, these low-top sneakers boast the original Air cushioning in the sole, providing excellent support for everyday wear. The perforated toe box ensures breathability, while the durable rubber outsole offers superior traction on various surfaces. Our experts state this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking to add a piece of basketball history to their collection, combining vintage aesthetics with modern performance.

title: Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink translates one of the most iconic silhouettes into a performance driven format without losing its cultural weight. The white base keeps the look clean and familiar, while fir and elemental pink accents introduce subtle contrast that gives the shoe a fresh personality on and off the course. The low cut shape stays true to the original design, maintaining the visual DNA that has defined the Air Jordan 1 for decades.

Golf adaptations of classic Jordans continue to gain traction because they merge sport function with lifestyle credibility. This pair captures that balance, offering something that feels just as relevant in casual settings as it does in play. For collectors, it represents the ongoing expansion of Jordan Brand into new spaces while still honoring the legacy that made the silhouette iconic.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $175.

title: Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts
description:
The Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts arrives with a smooth white leather upper with black Durabuck overlays and Swooshes. At the ankle, a traditional Wings logo nods to the origins of the Air Jordan collection. A Jumpman woven tongue label and semi-translucent outsole add the finishing touch.

The Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts released in February of 2022 and retailed for $120.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA White Black
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA White Black offers a cleaner, more understated take on the same collaborative vision. Featuring a crisp white and black palette, this version leans into contrast and simplicity while still showcasing Union LA’s signature construction details. Exposed stitching, layered panels, and vintage-inspired finishes give the sneaker depth without relying on bold color.

This colorway highlights the balance between Fragment’s minimalist design language and Union’s love for visible craftsmanship. Subtle co-branding appears throughout the upper inlcuding Fragment's iconic thunderbolts on the heel, keeping the look refined and intentional rather than overt. The white leather panels brighten the silhouette, while black overlays on the heel ground the design, making it one of the most versatile pairs in the collaboration.

When the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA White Black released, it retailed for $205. Clean, thoughtful, and rich in collaborative detail, this pair stands out as a wearable yet highly collectible take on the Jordan 1.

title: Jordan 1 Mid SE Distressed White Field Silver
Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf UNC
description:
Taking inspiration from the original Air Jordan 1 High UNC from 1985, the Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf UNC features a smooth white leather upper with University Blue overlays and Swooshes. At the base, a deeply grooved sole gears golfers for terrains ranging from the fairway, green, and if you are unlucky, the bunker.

The Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf UNC released in February of 2022 and retailed for $130.

title: Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP Union White Canvas
description:
Union LA and Jordan are starting off 2023 with the release of the Air Jordan Retro AJKO Low SP Union. This marks the seventh silhouette Union and Jordan Brand have partnered on.

The collaboration between Union and Jordan brand comes with a white and neutral grey canvas upper, sail midsoles, and yellow stitching accents. The Jordan x Union AJKO Low SP features removable blue and grey swoosh patches with Union LA branding placed below.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP Union released January 27, 2023, with a retail price of $150.

title: Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat White Grey Fog
description:
The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat White Grey Fog seamlessly blends style and practicality, meticulously crafted to enhance speed and agility through its construction and stud placement.

A fusion of white and Grey Fog hues adorns the Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat colorway, exuding a modern and sleek aesthetic. The shoe's upper is composed of synthetic leather, not only augmenting its visual appeal but also ensuring durability. Its low-cut design permits extensive ankle mobility, and the lace closure ensures a snug fit. Additionally, the reinforced toe box incorporates perforations, granting added protection and breathability. Underneath, the cleat showcases rubber studs strategically placed with a wide configuration and external pods, ensuring great traction.

The most remarkable attribute of the Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat White Grey Fog is its strategically positioned wide studs. This innovative feature is expertly engineered to assist athletes in swift turns and maneuvers on the field, offering a heightened level of agility and responsiveness. The cleat debuted on June 1, 2023, for $140.

title: Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Game Royal
description:
The Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Game Royal updates the Air Jordan 1 Mid silhouette with football technology, including studs underfoot and abrasion-resistant materials.

Like the original Air Jordan 1, the Game Royal Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat boasts color blocking. White acts as the base, while Royal details stand out on the forefoot and heel overlays, the outsole and studs, the insole, and the Jumpman logo on the tongue. The collar, laces, Air Jordan Wings logo, and signature Swoosh logos add splashes of black. The upper is synthetic leather, which is more resistant to abrasions and weathering than traditional leather. Finally, perforations across the vamp allow the foot to breathe.

Our experts at StockX like the wide placement of the studs because it increases traction without sacrificing the athlete's ability to maneuver on the field. The Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Game Royal was released on June 21, 2023, and sold for $150.

title: Jordan 1 Low Golf White Legend Blue
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf White Legend Blue brings classic Jordan heritage onto the fairway with a crisp White base accented by Legend Blue and Blue Tint detailing. The familiar low cut silhouette keeps the design rooted in basketball history, while subtle adjustments make it ready for the course. Clean color blocking highlights the iconic paneling, giving the shoe a fresh and polished presence.

This pair stands out because it blends sport crossover appeal with timeless style. The white and blue combination feels sharp and versatile, echoing some of the most beloved Jordan palettes. Golfers who appreciate sneaker culture gravitate toward releases like this for their ability to carry legacy energy beyond the hardwood. It feels refined and confident, translating one of the most recognizable silhouettes into a performance ready format.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf White Legend Blue was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $155.
